text: # Call Transcript: KYC Re-verification Request **Document ID:** TRX_007 **Category:** C17 — KYC & Identity Verification **Department:** Compliance **Customer Scope:** all **Last Updated:** 2026-07-15 **Version:** 1.0 **Source Authority:** Internal Knowledge Base **Channel:** Voice (Call Centre) --- ## Conversation Agent: NovaTel Customer Care, this is Fatima. Customer: I got a message asking me to re-verify my KYC, is this genuine? Agent: Yes, this is a genuine periodic verification requirement. You can either complete it via Video KYC in the app under Account > KYC Update, or visit a store with original ID and address proof. Customer: What happens if I don't do it? Agent: If it isn't completed within the notified window, outgoing services may be suspended as per regulatory requirements, so I'd recommend completing it soon. Customer: Okay I'll do the video KYC now. Agent: Great, the process takes about 5 minutes. Let me know if you face any issues. Agent: Before we close this, can I just confirm the resolution has fully addressed your concern? Customer: Yes, that's sorted now, thank you. Agent: Perfect. I've added a note to your account and you'll also receive a confirmation SMS shortly. ## Diagnostic Notes (Internal) - Identity verified via registered number and OTP. - Relevant backend status checked before providing resolution timeline. - Case closed after customer confirmation; escalated only if unresolved beyond the stated SLA. ## Escalation This case was resolved on the first contact. ## Related Documents No directly linked documents are recorded for this item; refer to the
